messages:
maria_finance: Heads-up — invoice INV-2026-0421 to vendor DataKart is on hold. We tried to collect the W-9 via the vendor portal but their e-sign failed with an error. Can tax confirm whether we should gross-up or hold payment until fixed? :thinking:

jeff_gonzalez: @maria_finance can you drop the portal error here? I can poke the webhook logs quickly.

maria_finance: pasted error from the portal:```
POST /esign/submit 500
{
  "error": "invalid_signature",
  "detail": "signature verification failed for signer email: vendor+dk@example.com"
}
```

ashley_sales: Vendor says they signed twice and got a blank confirmation screen. They pinged their admin but asked if we can re-trigger the request.

ben_eng: @jgonzalez fyi — our portal recently added stricter timestamp checks. If their clock is off the signature token can be rejected. We can re-issue a new signature link with a fresh nonce.

jgonzalez: ok running script to re-issue signature link now. @e-sign-bot please trigger resend for vendor DataKart, signer vendor+dk@example.com, reference INV-2026-0421.

e-sign-bot: workflow:esign-resend started for request_id=es-9f2a. ETA ~ 30s. :robot_face:

maria_finance: Thanks. Tax team — if the vendor can't complete by EOD, do we gross-up or hold short on this vendor payment? This vendor is on a weekly payout cadence.

tax_team: For a missing valid W-9 we should hold payment rather than gross-up by default. Gross-up requires explicit contract terms and a signed gross-up addendum. If they can't provide before payout close, hold and escalate procurement for the supplier onboarding exception.

ashley_sales: Noted. I told vendor to use Chrome incognito and retry the link. Will follow up if they still see blank screen.

ben_eng: resend completed, new link sent: https://portal.redwood-inference.com/esign/confirm?token=es-9f2a. Also logged an instrumentation flag to capture user-agent and clock skew for failures.

maria_finance: Great. Putting invoice INV-2026-0421 on hold until we receive a valid signed W-9. If vendor confirms signed, will remove hold. Filing a quick exceptions ticket with procurement. :clipboard:

ashley_sales: vendor replied "confirmation received" — they attached a signed PDF. Uploading into Coupa and marking as received.

maria_finance: Received PDF and validated TIN. Removing hold and approving payout. Thanks everyone. :party_parrot:
